descFull: ProphitBet is a Machine Learning Soccer Bet prediction application. It analyzes the form of teams, computes match statistics and predicts the outcomes of a match using advanced Machine Learning (ML) methods. Additionally, it provides betting agents based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), which can learn optimal betting strategies.
